title: 第五卷三十九静依尘第五卷三十八翩翩公子
content_zh:
小金龙恶狠狠盯着那个望着清澜笑的人。
那人金袍玉冠，身姿端凝，龙角纹路与自身同源一脉。
它低头看看自己圆滚滚的身子、软短八爪，再抬眸望向那人。
一瞬妒意翻涌。
八爪齐张，奶凶嘶鸣，径直扑向颜丙。
将将就要碰到颜丙。
半空，却有一只素静白手轻轻兜住它。
霓涟垂眸，眸光沉静，指尖温软。
“别闹。”
一语极轻。
颜丙视线随那只手抬升。
落于腕间红绳，一粒银珠摇曳其间。
再抬，是人族不可能拥有的仙颜，而他的视线也直接撞进她的眼底。
瞬息之间。
霓涟美瞳骤缩，眸心浮起一圈淡金色虹膜，骤然亮起。
颜丙额间龙角微光迸发，温润玉色里破开一丝异动。
空气似在滋滋轻响，金银两色流光似陨石对撞，激起万千花火。
隔壁休息区的角落，霓家四妹静静倚着舱壁，五人同根连心，最是敏锐。
霓影最先微动睫毛，眼底掠过一丝极淡的诧异。她素来掌侦测、辨灵力，一眼便看穿这是上古龙蛇血脉的天然交感，非术法、非人为，是刻在本源里的呼应。她不说话，只轻轻抬手，对身侧四姐妹极轻地摇了摇头，示意无人打扰。
霓波指尖微顿，收起原本散开的感知网；霓光、霓影、霓波几人两两对视，眼底皆是了然的浅淡笑意。

五姐妹心性通透，素来克制。
不起哄、不打趣、不窥探，只安安静静立在远处，替大姐守住这一段无声无息的宿命相逢。
舱外廊道尽头，几道身影默然伫立。
杨思纯立在光影交界处，一身素色常服，身姿挺拔安稳。他素来沉静观局，眼底无半分戏谑，只静静看着舱内那一金一银的微光交织。紫月联邦步步走来，见过杀伐诡谲，见过人心翻覆，今日又见上古血脉沉淀千年的温柔羁绊。他唇角噙着一抹极淡的释然，局势渐明，盟友入心，皆是好事。
江流云负手立在他身侧，目光微沉，一瞬便捕捉到颜丙龙气、霓涟蛇息的同源共振。
他惯于权衡格局、推演利弊，此刻心底已然悄然落笔：龙族与霓家上古羁绊暗合天意，这不止是个人情愫，是紫月联邦未来最稳固的隐性纽带。他不多言，只将这一幕默默记在心底，归于星际棋局的一枚无声重子。
老刀倚在廊柱旁，那柄古朴短刀静悬腰侧，一身久经沙场的沉敛气度。他见惯生死胜负，不爱揣摩弯弯绕绕，只觉得舱内氛围干净温柔。征战半生，刀光剑影无数，难得见这般无声相守、宿命相逢的光景，眼底掠过一抹温和的微光。
凌霄然立在最后，一身利落劲装，眉眼清峻凛冽。他素来杀伐果决、心性冷硬，此刻看着舱内打闹温存的一幕，冷峻眉眼稍稍柔和。乱世征途、星海浮沉，终究要有些温柔牵绊，方能撑得住漫漫长路。
众人皆是旁观，无人惊扰。
紫月高层这群见惯大场面的人，早已习得最顶级的分寸——好看不语，知趣不扰。
舱内。
霓涟松手。
小金龙趁势蹿出，八爪乱挠，尽数撞在颜丙身前无形龙气屏障上，只漾开层层金纹。
它挠得指尖发麻，眼尾含泪，却不肯停。
清澜快步上前轻轻将它抱起，抓住它的一只爪爪作势向颜丙拍去。
颜丙眉头一皱竟不躲闪，嘴里发出痛叫：“唉哟。”
小金龙竟咯咯笑出了声。
少倾，它又勾住清澜的手示意。
清澜只能继续。
舱内紧绷的宿命氛围被这软糯幼稚的一幕彻底揉碎，漾开细碎温柔。

门外一众高层，皆是眼底微动，默默含了浅淡笑意。
涟向前小半步。
content_en:
Little Jinlong stared fiercely at the man who smiled at Qinglan.
The man had a golden robe and a jade crown, his figure was condensed, and his dragon horn patterns were of the same origin as his own.
It lowered its head to look at its chubby body and short paws, then raised its eyes to look at the man.
Jealousy surged for a moment.
All eight claws were spread out, the breasts neighed fiercely, and they rushed straight towards Yan Bing.
He is about to meet Yan Bing.
In mid-air, a Sujing white hand gently held it.
Ni Lian lowered his eyes, his eyes were calm and his fingertips were gentle.
"Don't make trouble."
A very light word.
Yan Bing's eyes followed that hand.
Falling on the red rope on the wrist, a silver bead swayed in it.
Looking up again, it was a beauty that humans could not possess, and his gaze directly hit her eyes.
In an instant.
Ni Lian's beautiful eyes suddenly shrank, and a circle of pale golden irises appeared in the center of her eyes, which suddenly lit up.
The dragon's horns on Yan Bing's forehead shimmered, and there was a hint of movement in the warm jade color.
The air seemed to be sizzling, and the gold and silver streams of light collided like meteorites, sparking thousands of fireworks.
In the corner of the rest area next door, the four sisters of the Ni family leaned quietly against the bulkhead. The five of them were connected by the same root and were the most sensitive.
Niying was the first to flutter her eyelashes, and a hint of surprise flashed across her eyes. She has always been able to detect and distinguish spiritual powers, and she can see at a glance that this is the natural interaction between the blood of ancient dragons and snakes. It is not a magic method or a man-made one, but a response engraved in the origin. She didn't speak, only raised her hand gently, and shook her head very gently to the four sisters beside her, indicating that no one would disturb them.
Ni Bo's fingertips paused slightly and put away the originally scattered sensory net; Ni Guang, Ni Ying, and Ni Bo looked at each other in pairs, with clear smiles in their eyes.
The five sisters have clear minds and have always been restrained.
No teasing, no teasing, no prying, just standing quietly in the distance, guarding this silent fateful encounter for the eldest sister.
At the end of the corridor outside the cabin, several figures stood silently.
Yang Sichun stood at the intersection of light and shadow, dressed in plain clothes, with a tall and steady posture. He always observed the situation calmly, without any hint of joking in his eyes. He only quietly watched the glimmer of gold and silver intertwining in the cabin. The Ziyue Federation has come step by step, and has seen treacherous killings, and has seen people's hearts turned upside down. Today, they have seen the gentle fetters of ancient bloodline that have been accumulated for thousands of years. There was a faint hint of relief on the corners of his lips. The situation gradually became clearer, and it was a good thing for allies to be in their hearts.
Jiang Liuyun stood beside him with his hands behind his back, his eyes darkened, and in an instant he caught the resonance of Yan Bing's dragon energy and neon snake breath.
He is accustomed to weighing the situation and deducing the pros and cons, and at this moment, he has quietly written in his heart: The ancient bond between the Dragon Clan and the Ni Family coincides with God's will. This is not only a personal sentiment, but also the most stable implicit bond for the future of the Ziyue Federation. He didn't say much, he just remembered this scene silently in his heart and regarded it as a silent baryon in the interstellar chess game.
The old sword was leaning against the pillar, the simple short sword hanging quietly at the side of his waist, with a calm demeanor that had been on the battlefield for a long time. He was used to seeing life and death, and he didn't like to speculate on the twists and turns. He just felt that the atmosphere in the cabin was clean and gentle. After half a lifetime of fighting, there were countless flashes of swords and shadows. It was rare to see such a silent and fateful encounter. A gentle glimmer flashed across his eyes.
Ling Xiaoran stood at the end, dressed neatly and elegantly, with serious features. He has always been decisive in killing and cold-hearted. Now, looking at the heartwarming scene in the cabin, his stern eyebrows softened slightly. In troubled times, journeys, and the ups and downs of the sea of ​​​​stars, after all, you need some gentle ties to be able to endure the long journey.
Everyone was watching, no one was disturbed.
Ziyue's senior management, who are accustomed to seeing big scenes, have already learned the best sense of propriety - they don't say anything when they are happy, and they don't disturb others when they are interested.
inside the cabin.
Ni Lian let go.
The little golden dragon took advantage of the situation and jumped out, claws scratching wildly, and all of them hit the invisible dragon energy barrier in front of Yan Bing, only causing layers of golden patterns to appear.
It scratched until its fingertips were numb, and there were tears at the end of its eyes, but it refused to stop.
Qinglan quickly stepped forward and gently picked it up, grabbed one of its paws and patted it towards Yan Bing.
Yan Bing frowned but did not dodge, and screamed in pain: "Ouch."
The little golden dragon actually chuckled.
Less leaning, it hooked Qinglan's hand again.meaning.
Qinglan could only continue.
The tight and fatalistic atmosphere in the cabin was completely shattered by this soft and childish scene, and was filled with tenderness.
The eyes of all the senior executives outside the door moved slightly, and they smiled silently.
Lian took a small half step forward.
